name: Peninsula Gardens Prepackaged Flower | Lime Headz
description: If you love the headband high this one is for you! Feel it right up in your forehead. Similar to Z terps with a lime kick to her. Zero citrus so if you don’t like citrus don’t let the lime scare you away. Bright green dense flowers with crazy good flavor transfer.
